reasons: Classification is correct: the original imposes a one-way non-solicit on us (Licensee) for the Term plus three years covering every employee of Licensor and its Affiliates — both duration >24 months and all-personnel scope are expressly walk-away under NOSOLICIT, so it fails the fallback and warrants a redline.

The redline reaches the fallback position on all material terms: mutual obligation, 12 months, limited to personnel directly involved, existing general-advertising and unsolicited-inquiry carve-outs preserved, and an express confirmation that unsolicited hires are permitted (no no-hire introduced).

The failed 'minimal edit' check (0.686 changed-character ratio) is explained by the substance: duration, mutuality and scope all had to be rewritten in a single sentence; the surrounding 'Solicit' definition was left untouched, which is the smallest edit that achieves the position.
Comment is accurate, concise, in the required voice, states what changed and cites the playbook position without lecturing.
Minor, non-disqualifying redundancy: the sentence carries both a 12-month post-termination tail and a 12-month post-involvement proviso; consider simplifying to one measuring point in negotiation.
